e.title: EIOPA 欧洲保险统计
e.summary: EIOPA 官方欧洲保险市场统计（eiopa.europa.eu）：欧盟保险业市场数据——保费/偿付能力/财务指标全量统计
e.body: EIOPA Insurance Statistics（eiopa.europa.eu/tools-and-data/insurance-statistics）是欧洲保险与职业养老金管理局（EIOPA）的官方保险市场统计数据源：涵盖欧洲保险市场整体与各国细分——保费收入、赔付、Solvency II 偿付能力比率、财务与产品结构等（基于监管申报数据的聚合统计）。对 RIAA：欧洲保险市场的官方统计权威（Solvency II 语境的数据全景）——与 [[eiopa-monthly-rfr-check]]（无风险利率曲线工具）、[[eiopar]]（R 客户端）互补成 EIOPA 数据全家；欧洲市场比较/跨国分析的首选官方源。

e.summary_en: Official EIOPA European insurance market statistics (eiopa.europa.eu): EU insurance industry data — premiums/solvency/financial aggregates
e.summary_hk: EIOPA 官方歐洲保險市場統計（eiopa.europa.eu）：歐盟保險業市場數據——保費/償付能力/財務指標全量統計
e.body_en: EIOPA Insurance Statistics (eiopa.europa.eu/tools-and-data/insurance-statistics) is the official insurance market statistics source of the European Insurance and Occupational Pensions Authority (EIOPA): pan-European and country-level insurance market data — premium income, claims, Solvency II solvency ratios, financial and product structure (aggregates built from supervisory reporting data). For RIAA: the official statistical authority for the European insurance market (the full data picture in the Solvency II context) — complements [[eiopa-monthly-rfr-check]] (risk-free curve tooling) and [[eiopar]] (R client) into the EIOPA data family; the first-choice official source for European cross-country market comparisons.
e.body_hk: EIOPA Insurance Statistics（eiopa.europa.eu/tools-and-data/insurance-statistics）是歐洲保險與職業養老金管理局（EIOPA）的官方保險市場統計數據源：涵蓋歐洲保險市場整體與各國細分——保費收入、賠付、Solvency II 償付能力比率、財務與產品結構等。對 RIAA：歐洲保險市場的官方統計權威（Solvency II 語境的數據全景）——與 [[eiopa-monthly-rfr-check]]（無風險利率曲線工具）、[[eiopar]]（R 客戶端）互補成 EIOPA 數據全家；歐洲市場比較/跨國分析的首選官方源。
